decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line changelog entry under Enhancements [ev-f7d3abb12e99]. It says metrics now support gRPC and gRPC-Web, but not what changes for an existing environment that does nothing. The proposed statement says metrics endpoints now accept gRPC requests, which the excerpt does not say and probably misreads it. Deciding between behavior-change (for example, if existing metric labels or values change for gRPC traffic) and none needs the PR #9483 description or docs showing how metrics output changes.
